name: a1-evo-audio-expert
description: EvoBurrow is an unofficial, cross-platform A1 Evo AcoustiX, REW, and Denon/Marantz calibration companion

interface.shortDescription: A careful little control room for A1 Evo and your AVR.
interface.longDescription: EvoBurrow inspects A1 Evo AcoustiX artifacts, runs protected REW workflows, maps calibration presets, and safely operates supported Denon/Marantz receivers. Unofficial and community-built. Support development at https://buymeacoffee.com/daredoole.
defaultPrompt: Audit my latest A1 Evo calibration safely.
Map my A1 calibrations to Denon presets.
Diagnose my A1 and REW setup without guessing.
